reviews.text: Visited Cancun a few times and stayed in a few different hotels over the time. Paradisus by far beats them all. It’s my number #1 place next to home. 🥰🥰🥰. The staff is unmatched…!! reviews.author: Sarah Jane Ramos
reviews.text: We celebrated our 10th year anniversary at Paradisus Cancun where we got married in 2016 and as always, very pleased with our stay. The staff/service are excellent. Big shout to our concierge Jared Osario. He was amazing, always on top of things, never fail to check to on us and very accommodating. Also, Julio at the reserve is great, very attentive. He is so friendly and always smiling. Lucas at the Aqua Marina provided excellent service. Basically, our overall experience at Cancun Paradisus are excellent. We will definitely come back here. It’s a home away from home. ❤️❤️

reviews.author: Denis Tamayo
reviews.text: Excellent service, hotel was great. I really enjoyed Capella restaurant, Claudio was amazing.

reviews.author: Niaz Nejad
reviews.text: Agua Marina - food was OUTSTANDING!!! Jonathan took amazing care of us. He made recommendations for appetizers, main course and dessert. He also suggested a delicious non alcoholic sparkling rose. Took all my allergies into consideration and took amazing care of us. 100 outta 5.

reviews.author: Youngsung Chun
reviews.text: Manager Daniel served us today, and he was excellent. If I come back here, I would love to be served by him again. He was so kind that the food was delicious, and the atmosphere was wonderful. Thank you, Manager Daniel.

reviews.author: mindy sarrazine
reviews.text: We ate at Kao our server Daniel was excellent! He brought us a little extra treat we didn’t order and it was delightful! I highly recommend this restaurant when staying at Paradise Cancun!

reviews.author: Kellee Miner
reviews.text: Sergio and Fernanda were both wonderful, I recommend upgrading to a concierge room. Fernanda helped ensure my kids blankets were washed in time for bed. Both were personable and kind.

reviews.author: Ana Karina Torrealba
reviews.text:
Our second home in Cancun! A 5-star experience thanks to an incredible team ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Whenever we travel to Cancun, we choose this hotel because they literally make us feel at home from the very first second. The hospitality and level of service here are out of this world.

We want to give a special mention and a huge thank you to our concierge, Rodolfo. He was impeccable, extremely attentive to every little detail, and made sure our stay was simply spectacular. You're the best, Rodolfo!
We also have to take our hats off to the food. We want to thank each and every one of the restaurant managers, who go the extra mile to make every meal a delicious experience with top-notch service.

If you're looking for a place in Cancun where luxury meets genuine warmth, the Meliá Paradisus is the place for you. We'll be back again and again!

reviews.author: Edgardo Reyes
reviews.text: Perla made us two smoothies outside of business hours as a sign of her incredible kindness and dedication. We are very grateful. Thank you!

reviews.author: Viki Ramirez
reviews.text: My husband and I  came for our honeymoon and had Fernanda as our concierge throughout our entire stay. She booked all our reservations and made our whole vacation magical. We definitely plan to come back with our family again and again . Such a beautiful paradise.

Our waiter Armando was undoubtedly the best at Paradisus Cancun—super attentive and dedicated to explaining all the dishes. Chef Miguel was incredibly fast and his food was perfectly seasoned. Congratulations to the manager, Natanael, for creating such a pleasant and efficient atmosphere. Thank you to the entire Blue Agave team!

reviews.text: Alejandro and Francisco from Gastro Hall. Both are super helpful. We were struggling with vegetarian food for our baby and Alejandro spoke to the chef for us and was very accommodating. Both are always friendly and happy to help. They had time to learn our names and always check in on us. Always serving everyone with a smile. Atilano served us at blue agave one evening and he was very friendly. He took the time to speak with us about our holiday and he interacted well with our baby son. He ensured our baby got his food first and suggested different vegetarian options for us.

reviews.author: Mar Chello
reviews.text: An incredible stay from start to finish. The staff genuinely make you feel like family — special thanks to Natalia and Galdino, our Destination Concierges, for the warm welcome and thoughtful touches throughout the trip. The resort offers so much you never need to leave the property: incredible food variety across multiple restaurants, beautiful grounds, and a stunning beach. Rooms were clean and well organized, and security is excellent with guards checking every car and pedestrian at the entrance. A huge shoutout to the Kidsdom team — Marylin, Gipsy, and Uriel were absolutely wonderful with our son, making the kids’ club a real highlight of the trip. A truly relaxing, memorable family vacation — we’ll be back.

reviews.author: Noemí Silva
reviews.text: My family and I had an amazing time. The hotel service was excellent. We consider the food options important for an all-inclusive resort, and this hotel doesn't disappoint. The restaurants are fantastic. The Kids Club service is superb, and I especially want to thank Maylin, Esme, and Gypsy for their attention to my little one, who had a truly happy vacation at the club. The room was very nice with an ocean view, and the room service was always excellent. Another thing my family loved was the coffee bar/ice cream shop. The service from all the baristas was excellent. The pools were plentiful and fun. The evening shows were also good, and we had a great time. Overall, a very good experience.
